metadata.title: Key Management

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing the lifecycle, protection, and authorized use of cryptographic keys.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Key management systems, hardware security modules, cryptographic key stores, and lifecycle automation.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing cryptographic keys as long-lived institutional assets.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Key management supports and underpins institutional encryption requirements.

metadata.remarks: Key Management defines trust properties required to ensure cryptographic keys remain protected, trustworthy, and appropriately used throughout their lifecycle. This pattern does not define encryption policy or application-level key usage logic.

components.title: Key Generation
components.description: Controls the secure creation of cryptographic keys.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Compromise of weakly generated or predictable cryptographic keys.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Use of cryptographically strong and approved key generation processes.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic keys are generated using approved algorithms and randomness.

components.title: Key Storage and Protection
components.description: Ensures cryptographic keys are securely stored and shielded from unauthorized access.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized access to stored cryptographic keys.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Hardware-backed or logically isolated secure key storage.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Keys are stored in secure, access-controlled repositories.

components.title: Key Rotation and Renewal
components.description: Defines when and how cryptographic keys are rotated or renewed.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Long-term exploitation of compromised but unrotated keys.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Keys are rotated or renewed according to defined schedules or risk thresholds.

components.title: Key Revocation and Destruction
components.description: Invalidates and securely destroys obsolete or compromised keys.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Reuse of revoked or compromised cryptographic keys.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controlled revocation and secure destruction of keys.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Keys are revoked and destroyed when no longer authorized for use.

components.title: Key Access Governance
components.description: Governs who may access or use cryptographic keys and for what purposes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of legitimate permissions to misuse cryptographic keys.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Role-based and policy-driven control of key usage.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to cryptographic keys is restricted and audited.
